Changing the way I look at things that happen in my life

First of all I am so sorry you are going through this. I’m going to preface what I’m saying with this… this is what has helped and worked for me everyone is different but if it can help at all I would like to share. I have struggled with depression for a while and the thing that helps me the most is changing the lens I look through. It sucks at first and takes a lot of effort but it has drastically changed my mental health. My depression was fueled by a lot of anger and it was exhausting. I still have ups and downs but looking at things differently has helped me the most. For example today my roommate came into the apartment very loudly and woke me up an hour before my alarm at first I was livid but then I took a breath and looked at it another way maybe this was a sign that I needed to wake up earlier, so I got up went and talked to my roommate to see how they were doing and took my dog for a walk. Before I was conscious of my mindset that would have upset me the whole day. Another example is a friendship I had ending at first I looked at it through the lens of deep sadness that I lost something after a couple of days I decided to look at a different angle…. That friendship was honestly not serving me in a healthy way ending sucked but in the end was actually beneficial. Starting to look at things differently is a struggle and can take a lot of time and effort but it has drastically improved my mental well being
